buy.title: Buy tickets
buy.intro: Buy your tickets. Pay the club afterwards: numbers are assigned at random once payment is confirmed. Only paid tickets take part.
buy.name: Name

confirm.title: Order saved
confirm.saveLink: Find your tickets again under My tombolas, after logging in.
confirm.statusPaid: Paid. Your tickets are in the draw

scratch.instruction: Scratch the silver panel: the prize, if any, was assigned to this number on the wheel.
scratch.howto: After you save the tombola, the wheel assigns prizes to ticket numbers. After payment, scratch to see whether your number won a prize.

results.title: The draw
results.empty: The draw has not taken place yet.

admin.loginLead: Log in with the organizer email and password.
admin.qrLead: The buyer scans this code with Wave. Doaty Délice, affiliated with Rotaract IUGB Club, receives the payment.
admin.drawModeScratchHelp: After you save, the wheel assigns each prize to a ticket number, before anyone reserves or pays. Players scratch as soon as a ticket is paid. The public winners list is not shown.
admin.drawModeRouletteHelp: Tickets are just numbers. Everyone watches the wheel: it names the winners, prize by prize.
admin.assignFirst: Spin the wheel to assign each prize to a ticket number before sales.
admin.needAssignment: Assign the prizes on the wheel first.
admin.drawShowHelpScratch: Save the tombola, then spin this wheel. It assigns each prize to a number. Buyers are not shown here. After sales, close and notify so players remember to scratch.
admin.drawHelpScratch: Prizes are already on the numbers. This only closes the tombola and notifies players. It cannot be undone.
admin.drawHelpSeal: The wheel picks a winning number for each prize. After that you do not assign lots again. Players scratch once paid.
admin.scratchesHelp: Prizes are on the winning numbers from the wheel assignment. As soon as a player scratches, their ticket appears here live.
admin.statusDraft: Draft. Not visible on the public site yet
admin.draftHelp: This tombola is not on the public site yet. Click Open sales to show it.
admin.createdVisible: Tombola created and visible on the public site.
admin.createdDraft: Tombola saved. If another one is already on sale, this one stays a draft until you open its sales.
admin.title: Title
admin.physicalHelp: For someone with no account or no connection. Add their name: the ticket is sold at once and enters the draw. You can do this as soon as the tombola is created, even as a draft. These tickets do not appear in the online ticket office.
admin.physicalSaved: Physical tickets saved. They are sold and will be in the draw.
admin.waveHelp: Wave does not send an automatic confirmation. The buyer pastes the transaction ID after paying: it appears on their row. Check it in Wave, then click Mark paid. Numbers are then assigned at random and a receipt is emailed.
admin.markPaidBody: Mark {{name}} as paid ({{amount}})? Numbers will be assigned at random and a receipt will be emailed.
admin.markPaidBodyRef: Mark {{name}} as paid ({{amount}})? Wave ID: {{ref}}. Numbers will be assigned at random and a receipt will be emailed.
admin.unmarkPaidBody: Remove {{name}} from the draw? Their numbers go back into the pool and can be sold again. The order returns to unpaid. This is only possible before the draw, to fix a mistake.
admin.cancelBody: Cancel {{name}}'s order? The tickets go back into the pool. If a Wave payment was already made, check the ID before refunding.
admin.drawShowHelp: Close sales first, then project this screen. The wheel names the winners, prize by prize, in front of everyone.
admin.drawWarn: Some orders are still unpaid. They will be left out of the draw.
admin.closeSalesFirst: Close sales before starting the draw. Nobody can buy afterwards.
admin.drawHelp: Only paid tickets take part. The first ticket drawn wins 1st prize, the second wins 2nd prize, and so on. Everyone sees the result. This cannot be undone.
admin.noPaid: No paid tickets: the draw cannot run.
admin.needPrizes: Add at least one prize before opening sales.
admin.donationsHelp: Wave donations have no automatic confirmation. Match the ID and amount in Wave, then mark received.
admin.markReceivedBody: Mark {{name}}'s donation ({{amount}}) as received? Wave ID: {{ref}}.
admin.deleteHelp: You can delete a tombola after sales are closed, or after the draw. Prizes, tickets and buyers are removed with it.
admin.deleteBody: Permanently delete this tombola, with its prizes, tickets and buyers? This cannot be undone.

errors.alreadyScratched: A ticket from this purchase has already been scratched. You cannot undo it.
errors.invalidForm: Check the title (at least 2 characters) and the prizes.
errors.apiDown: The API is not reachable. Restart the backend server, then try again.
errors.anotherOnSale: Another tombola still has ticket sales open. Close it before opening this one.
errors.eventNotFinished: You can only delete a tombola after sales are closed or after the draw.
errors.activeEvent: A tombola is already in progress. Edit it, or finish it before creating another.
